game: Retail USA Ninja Gaiden Black; validated by ngb_check_xbe
controls: Only Up/1 (Melee Weapons) and Down/2 (Consumables) open the menu. Left/Right and their rebound Previous/Next actions only browse while open. Open: Up/Down changes category; A/Enter confirms, B/Escape cancels. All six actions rebindable. Original four IDs and INI keys retained.
action_gate: Native 0x00166BD0 is checked on each guest frame. Open during an action; categories, equip/use and optional pause wait for the native inventory gate. A blocked confirmation is discarded, never deferred. Cancel and within-category browsing remain available.
presentation: Lower-left cross ordered Ninpo, Ranged Weapons, Melee Weapons, Consumables from top to bottom. Card paper uses 44.89% original brightness; frames, artwork, arrows and quantities retain their own colours. Selected weapon/item names, level text, waiting-for-action text and empty-category labels are hidden. Only Black assets: saveload.spr panel, mis_menu.spr frame, cos_menu.spr arrows and native inventory icons. GPU blur/dimming only while Quick Menu Pause is active; waiting and Pause Off remain clear. Menu stays sharp.
validation: 2026-10-20: Windows Release build and clean-source patch/package checks passed. Only runtime change from 0.12 is removal of empty-category caption drawing; input, inventory, pause, settings and shaders retain their earlier checks. No gameplay, Vulkan runtime or listening test for 0.13; user will playtest the built update.
scale_off: 0 displays as Off and disables opening, modal input, pause and overlay. Pending commands are discarded; an owned pause is released.
upgrade_policy: Reapply source, rebuild and run the regression checks for each upstream update. The supplied executable contains its recorded upstream version; it cannot acquire future upstream changes automatically.
